title: The Broken Clock
scene: At 6:05 PM, the town hall clock stopped. The tower stairs were roped off from 5:50 to 6:20.

suspects.name: Dora Fenn
suspects.testimony: I was at the front desk at 6:05, sorting mail.
suspects.alibiProof: The mail log shows Dora's initials at 6:04 and 6:11.

suspects.name: Emil Pike
suspects.testimony: I was mopping the lobby at 6:05.
suspects.alibiProof: The lobby camera shows Emil at 6:03 and 6:09.

suspects.name: Freya Lund
suspects.testimony: I was in the tower at 6:05, winding the gears.
suspects.contradiction: The tower rope barrier was intact at 6:05, and gear oil marked Freya's hands.

suspects.name: Gus Ash
suspects.testimony: I was in the courtyard at 6:05, taking photos.
suspects.alibiProof: Gus's photo of the clock is timestamped 6:04.
